```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
if (!exists("FAMILY", inherits = FALSE) ||
    length(FAMILY) != 1L ||
    !FAMILY %in% c("ppv", "ppa")) {
  stop("records.distributions: set exactly one response family.", call. = FALSE)
}
.RECORDS_LOCAL <- !exists("RECORDS_EDA", inherits = FALSE)
if (.RECORDS_LOCAL) {
  .RECORDS_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
    file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
  )
  .RECORDS_DATASET <- names(.RECORDS_CONFIG$datasets)
  if (length(.RECORDS_DATASET) != 1L || !nzchar(.RECORDS_DATASET)) {
    stop("records.distributions: one dataset must be declared.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS_EDA_FILES <- c(
    file.path(root, "data", "datasets", sprintf("%s.csv", .RECORDS_DATASET)),
    file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv"),
    file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json"),
    file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json")
  )
  if (any(!file.exists(RECORDS_EDA_FILES))) {
    stop("records.distributions: required model products are missing.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS_EDA_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
    RECORDS_EDA_FILES[3L], simplifyVector = TRUE
  )
  RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES <- as.character(
    .RECORDS_CONFIG$responses$names
  )
  RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES <- RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES[
    grepl("^pp[av][LTV]$", RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES)
  ]
  RECORDS_EDA_SOURCE_NAMES <- as.character(RECORDS_EDA_CONFIG$sources)
  RECORDS_EDA_UNITS <- unlist(RECORDS_EDA_CONFIG[c("ppv", "ppa")])
  if (!length(RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES) ||
      any(!c("ppv", "ppa") %in% names(RECORDS_EDA_UNITS)) ||
      !length(RECORDS_EDA_SOURCE_NAMES)) {
    stop("records.distributions: incomplete response or source contract.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS_EDA <- data.table::fread(
    RECORDS_EDA_FILES[1L],
    select = c("SampleID", "set", RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES)
  )
  RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES <- data.table::fread(RECORDS_EDA_FILES[2L])
  if (anyDuplicated(RECORDS_EDA$SampleID) ||
      anyDuplicated(RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES$SampleID) ||
      !setequal(RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES$Source, RECORDS_EDA_SOURCE_NAMES)) {
    stop("records.distributions: invalid dataset or source keys.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS_EDA <- RECORDS_EDA[set == "train"][
    RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES, on = "SampleID", Source := i.Source
  ]
  if (anyNA(RECORDS_EDA$Source) ||
      nrow(RECORDS_EDA) != nrow(RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES) ||
      !setequal(RECORDS_EDA$SampleID, RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES$SampleID)) {
    stop("records.distributions: QDS and source keys do not form a complete join.",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  RECORDS_EDA <- data.table::melt(
    RECORDS_EDA,
    id.vars = c("SampleID", "Source"),
    measure.vars = RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES,
    variable.name = "response",
    value.name = "value",
    variable.factor = FALSE
  )[is.finite(value)][, value := 10^value]
  if (RECORDS_EDA[, any(!is.finite(value) | value <= 0)]) {
    stop("records.distributions: invalid physical amplitudes.", call. = FALSE)
  }
}
.COMPONENTS <- c("L", "V", "T")
.RECORDS_IDS <- paste0(FAMILY, .COMPONENTS)
if (!setequal(
      .RECORDS_IDS,
      RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES[
        grepl(sprintf("^%s[LTV]$", FAMILY), RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES)
      ]
    )) {
  stop(sprintf("records.distributions: incomplete %s response family.", FAMILY),
       call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("FAMILY_LABEL", inherits = FALSE)) FAMILY_LABEL <- toupper(FAMILY)
RESP <- setNames(paste(FAMILY_LABEL, .COMPONENTS, sep = "."), .RECORDS_IDS)
TABS <- setNames(.COMPONENTS, .RECORDS_IDS)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- paste0(
    "Observed %s distribution in the model-fitting sample ",
    "($n = %d$; %s; range %.3g--%.3g %s). ",
    "Columns show the number of observations in each amplitude interval; ",
    "the rescaled density represents the same distribution on the count scale."
  )
}
if (!exists("Y_AXIS", inherits = FALSE)) Y_AXIS <- "Count"
if (!exists("SERIES", inherits = FALSE)) {
  SERIES <- c(histogram = "Histogram", density = "Rescaled density")
}
if (!exists("TOOLTIP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  TOOLTIP <- c(
    amplitude = "Amplitude",
    count = "Count",
    density = "Rescaled density"
  )
}
HISTOGRAM_BREAKS <- 50L
UNIT <- as.character(RECORDS_EDA_UNITS[[FAMILY]])
if (length(UNIT) != 1L || is.na(UNIT) || !nzchar(UNIT)) {
  stop(sprintf("records.distributions: units.json does not define %s.", FAMILY),
       call. = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
for (.ID in names(RESP)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", TABS[[.ID]]))
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/records.distributions.cell.qmd",
    stem = sprintf("frecords-%s", .ID),
    labels = "rewrite",
    vars = list(
      CAP = CAP,
      HISTOGRAM_BREAKS = HISTOGRAM_BREAKS,
      ID = .ID,
      RESPONSE_LABEL = RESP[[.ID]],
      SERIES = SERIES,
      TOOLTIP = TOOLTIP,
      UNIT = UNIT,
      Y_AXIS = Y_AXIS
    ),
    root = root
  )
}
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(
  CAP, FAMILY, FAMILY_LABEL, HISTOGRAM_BREAKS, RESP, SERIES, TABS, TOOLTIP,
  UNIT, Y_AXIS, .COMPONENTS, .RECORDS_IDS
)
if (knitr::is_html_output()) rm(.ID)
if (.RECORDS_LOCAL) {
  rm(
    RECORDS_EDA, RECORDS_EDA_CONFIG, RECORDS_EDA_FILES,
    RECORDS_EDA_RESPONSES, RECORDS_EDA_SOURCES, RECORDS_EDA_SOURCE_NAMES,
    RECORDS_EDA_UNITS, .RECORDS_CONFIG, .RECORDS_DATASET
  )
}
rm(.RECORDS_LOCAL)
```
